pillars.title: How OpenLease is different
pillars.subtitle: Car leasing in Australia was built for permanent residents on fixed terms. We built OpenLease for you.

openTerms.title: Open terms
openTerms.body: Your lease matches your visa — not the other way around. 9 to 24 months, any month in between, including odd terms like 15.

allInclusive.title: All-inclusive
allInclusive.body: A brand-new car with one weekly price. Insurance, servicing, maintenance, tyres, rego, CTP and roadside — everything but fuel.

noCredit.title: No Australian credit history needed
noCredit.body: You're approved on your employment contract, salary and visa — even before you arrive in Australia.

included.title: One weekly price. Everything but fuel.
included.subtitle: No surprise bills, no separate policies, no rego renewals. If the car needs it, it's covered.
included.fuelExcludedNote: The only thing you pay for is fuel.

delivery.title: Delivered on arrival. Collected when you leave.
delivery.body: We deliver your car to the airport or your new home, ready to drive. At the end of your term, we come and collect it. Zero hassle at the two moments you least need it.
delivery.point1: Airport or home delivery, timed to your arrival
delivery.point2: Fully registered, insured and fuelled for handover

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From your visa grant to your driveway in four steps.

1.title: Choose your car & term
1.body: Pick a brand-new car and slide the term to match your visa.

2.title: Apply online
2.body: Apply before you arrive — approval on your contract, salary and visa. No Australian credit history required.

3.title: We deliver on arrival
3.body: Your car is waiting — at the airport or your new front door.

4.title: Drive. We collect at the end.
4.body: One weekly payment covers everything but fuel. When your term ends, we collect the car.

partners.title: For employers & migration partners
partners.body: Relocating international talent? Give your people mobility from day one. We partner with employers, relocation agents and migration specialists to make cars part of the landing package — with consolidated billing and priority delivery.
partners.point1: Fleet-style terms for individual visa lengths
partners.point2: One invoice, many drivers, zero admin
partners.point3: Priority delivery slots for arrival dates

who.a: Professionals coming to Australia on temporary visas — skilled workers, graduates, students and working-holiday makers — who need a car for exactly the length of their stay.

included.q: What does the weekly price include?
included.a: Everything except fuel: comprehensive insurance, servicing, maintenance, tyres, registration and CTP, 24/7 roadside assistance, plus delivery and collection. One payment, no surprises.

credit.q: Do I need an Australian credit history?
credit.a: No. We approve you on your employment contract, salary and visa. You can be approved before you even land in Australia.

term.q: Can the lease really match my exact visa length?
term.a: Yes. Any term from 9 to 24 months — including non-standard terms like 15 months. Set the slider to your visa length and that's your lease.

km.a: Pricing is based on up to {km} km per week. If you drive more, excess kilometres are charged at a published per-km rate — you'll always know it up front.

end.q: What happens at the end of my lease?
end.a: We come and collect the car — from your home, work or the airport. If your visa is extended, you can extend or re-lease instead.

apply.q: Can I apply before I arrive in Australia?
apply.a: Yes — most of our customers do. Apply with your employment contract and visa, get approved, and your car will be waiting when you land.

disclaimer.text: All pricing is indicative and based on the driver travelling up to {km} km per week. Excess kilometres are charged at a published per-km rate. Final pricing is confirmed on application and subject to assessment and approval. OpenLease agreements are consumer leases provided under applicable Australian consumer credit law.
